source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article states that it characterizes admissible bounds in the class of quadratic forms and optimizes conservative bounds under experimenter objectives.
The paper establishes general finite-population CLTs for randomization-based causal analyses.
The paper derives a sharp sampling-variance lower bound for a randomized 2-by-2 factorial design with binary outcomes.
The paper gives consistent estimators of sharp variance bounds for the difference-in-means estimator under complete randomization.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1305.6156; corroborates Annals of Applied Statistics 11, 1912--1947
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives randomization-based interference estimators, variance estimators, and local-dependence asymptotics for a social-network application.
The paper develops imputation and contrast routes to conservative variance estimation for randomized experiments.
The paper studies balanced-design inference for binary treatment effects under random potential outcomes and derives conservative CMH- and Robins-type estimators.
The paper provides a design-based matrix framework for variance-bound estimation for arbitrary linear estimators and experimental designs.
The paper reports a randomized anti-conflict intervention across 56 schools with measured school social networks.
The paper studies conservative Horvitz--Thompson variance estimation under zero pairwise inclusion probabilities, precisely the omitted close precursor.
